author: jacobrutherford
quote: 13 years and 2 billion dollars later this is trash compared to what was showed iv played almost 16 hours and this game is basically scripted in was that make it so you can’t even play how you want it so linear as a person I should be able to make my own choices plus the fighting is terrible just one button to attack ? Rdr2 was better than that honestly the game was way too hyped up for what they delivered rockstar knew it would be a cash grab with no way to return it or refund sad
